scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.format: prettier --write client/app client/next.config.ts server/src server/test tests playwright.config.ts package.json
scripts.audit: npm audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix server audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix client audit --audit-level=high
